originalTitle: The Life and Times of Rosie the Riveter

title.en: The Life and Times of Rosie the Riveter
title.tr: The Life and Times of Rosie the Riveter

overview.en: Documentary about women's experiences of labour, in factories, mines and dockyards, in the USA during the second World War and how it affected their work and career aspirations once they were encouraged to give up such employment in peacetime.
